bmt-2025-power-1-04.answer: Two R2 moves, four R3 moves and two further R2 moves, then one R1 move.

bmt-2025-power-1-05.answer: R2 x3, R3 x2, R3 x3 and R2 x1, R2 x2 and R1 x2, then R2, R2, R1.
